THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
STUDIO
138
STUDY 143
Sequined Halter & Leather Mini
Rights check
Source: 25030.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, dark straight hair
stands full-length against a white backdrop. She wears
a sheer lilac halter top with a deep V neckline, covered
in dark sequin and beaded floral embroidery, with a thin
beaded choker. A distressed black leather mini skirt
with studs and a low waistband completes the look.
Black strappy mules finish the outfit. Her expression is
calm and direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of lilac,
black, and silver. Glamorous and edgy, in the style of
an evening fashion lookbook.
Glamorous, edgy, bold
WORKING NOTES
- The sequined embroidery and distressed leather mini are
the key contrasts.
- Add 'full-length' to keep the shoes in frame.
Try this: Use full-length framing to include the shoes.
